items.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO after 33 years, effective immediately - CFO Colette Kress steps in as interim CEO with earnings Tuesday
items.subheader: The board announced the co-founder's exit as president, CEO and director Thursday morning. TechCrunch reports he was ousted after reports of affairs with an alleged Chinese spy and a direct report. Kress, CFO since 2013, leads the ~$3.8 trillion company with no succession plan in place.

quotes.text: We will continue advancing the work that has made Nvidia a leader in accelerated computing and AI, and execute on the opportunities ahead.

items.title: Thursday injury report: RT Jaylon Moore and DT Peter Woods (DNP both days) are tracking to miss Sunday - Ezeudu starts at RT, KC signs DT Marcus Harris
items.subheader: Mahomes, Rice, Worthy and Kelce were full participants again Thursday; rookie RB Jaydn Ott was added as limited with a hamstring. On the Falcons' side, WR Zachariah Branch sat both days and three defenders were downgraded Thursday.
items.image_alt: Jaylon Moore takes the field at Arrowhead

items.title: Gameday eve: Huskers up to 14.5-point favorites at Rutgers after KJ Duff's season-ending surgery - 11:30 a.m. CT on BTN, 44 degrees at kickoff
items.subheader: Duff (45 catches, 771 yards, 9 TDs) was the one player Nebraska most wanted off the field with Andrew Marshall out. A win makes NU bowl-eligible for a third straight season and 8-0 vs Rutgers, tying its most wins against an FBS opponent without a loss.

items.title: Anthropic shares start trading Nov 19 - the $70-78 IPO range is reportedly multiple-times oversubscribed
items.subheader: The date is official per The Verge, with the final S-1 amendment and prospectus filed this week. AP notes the debut could top SpaceX's record IPO.

items.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen: Google's fast agentic model edges Argon on the Artificial Analysis index (51 to 50) at $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens
items.subheader: Flat pricing across a 1M-token context, 2.5x faster than 3.8 Flash with triple its Terminal-Bench score (57% vs 18.2%). New Orchestrator in Antigravity hot-swaps Carbon and Hydrogen mid-session: near-Carbon success rates at 24% less quota, 19% faster.

quotes.text: Today, we're introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen, bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone — with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows.

items.title: ChatGPT Wallet: agents can now pay with network-issued tokens - no card details shared, biometric approval on every purchase
items.subheader: Built with Amex, Mastercard and Visa; rolls out today in dots for US ChatGPT Pro subscribers. OpenAI also published a Commerce Partner Playbook: claim your business, allow signed Web Bot Auth requests, and teach risk systems (Forter, Riskified, Stripe, Adyen) not to decline agent purchases.

quotes.text: ChatGPT Wallet marks our first American Express Agentic Commerce Experiences integration, enabling eligible Card Members to use their Amex Card while reviewing and approving each purchase.

items.title: Self-hosted Claude Managed Agents enters private beta: run Anthropic's agent stack inside your own security perimeter
items.subheader: Sandboxes, credential handling and session history all stay in your infrastructure, with support for existing cloud providers and zero-data-retention compliance - the enterprise answer to 'who holds the agent's keys.'

items.title: Replit Agent can now make supply purchases and run Google Ads for your business, using Link with Visa and Stripe for the money side
items.subheader: Another agent gets a wallet the same week as ChatGPT Wallet: controlled transactions for business purchases, plus ad campaigns built from analyzing your content.

items.title: Perplexity ships Decider v1.3 and Decider Flash v1.3 - classification models that return calibrated probabilities for routing, ranking and evals
items.subheader: Both handle binary and multi-class tasks across text and vision, with a new span-highlighting feature for NER, PII detection and extractive QA.

items.title: Lurie breaks ground on a $72M Treasure Island behavioral health building: 300 treatment and recovery beds, opening late 2028
items.subheader: 44 new residential treatment beds, 84 new recovery-housing beds, and 172 beds relocating from old Navy housing. It's the first building in Treasure Island's stage-two development area, funded by Prop A bond money and state grants.

quotes.text: In San Francisco, we are fundamentally transforming our behavioral health response by building a system that helps people earlier, creates more pathways into treatment and recovery, and delivers results for people and neighborhoods alike.

items.title: Caltrain's downtown extension lands a $750M state grant - the biggest slice of a $1.3B statewide rail-funding round
items.subheader: The Portal - a two-mile tunnel from Fourth and King to the Salesforce Transit Center - is a $7.5B+ project. BART got $25M toward turning Ashby Station's west lot into 618 homes (307 affordable); Capitol Corridor got $40M for railcar refits.
items.image_alt: Rendering of the Caltrain Portal extension

items.title: SF now offers buprenorphine on demand at Maria X Martinez in SoMa - same-day first dose from clinicians patients already know
items.subheader: The ~$500K pilot (from Lurie's privately financed Breaking the Cycle Fund) targets a hard math problem: 2,800 shots given last year against ~37,500 San Franciscans with drug addiction, and only ~30% of patients stay on the medication six months.

quotes.text: Often, no matter whether it's treatment, shelter or housing, we lose people very quickly. So if somebody is ready, we get them in a vehicle, and we drive them straight here, and that opens a gateway to all types of other opportunities.
quotes.by: Mark Mazza, city street outreach supervisor

items.title: Kejelcha is out of Valencia (Dec 6) with an injury - the €1M world-record bonus now sits with Fotyen Tesfay, 55 seconds off the women's mark
items.subheader: The 1:59:41 London runner was the only sub-two man in the field; John Korir (2:02:24) now leads it, realistically chasing Lemma's 2:01:48 course record (€30K). Tesfay's 2:10:51 debut makes her the only athlete within a minute of Chepngetich's 2:09:56 - and Ngetich makes her marathon debut.
